verdict.rationale: Clerk documents an open-source migration tool that bulk-creates users in Clerk from a JSON or CSV file through the Backend API and respects rate limits. Its migration guide also names 'Basic Export / Import' and trickle migration as inbound strategies, so the import half of the story is covered. Missing for 10: evidence that password hashes can be imported, any documented way to export users (with hashes) out of Clerk to avoid lock-in, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the migration tool.
